// "Nobody" and "Everyone" anywhere in a text string: whole word, any case. 6 Nobody and 4 Everyone.
export const COUNT = [
  'Nobody saw you take the last cookie.', // nobody 1
  'You waited. Nobody came, and nobody called.', // nobody 2
  'Everyone laughed when the cake fell.', // everyone 1
  'Everyone knew, and everyone said nothing.', // everyone 2
  'EVERYONE and NOBODY clapped at the show', // everyone 1, nobody 1: any case
  "Nobody's perfect, but you came close.", // nobody 1: possessive
  `${name} said nobody was home at all.`, // nobody 1
]

// None of these count.
export const NO_COUNT = [
  'Nobody came.', // 12 characters: below the 14-character floor, so not a text string
  'Everyones phones were all switched off.', // not the whole word
  'Somebody and anyone were both there.',
]
